description: The ONE section type shared by two different page shapes: /security slot 2 and /about slot 2. Same component, two themes. On /about the heading is present and the four icons are the WHITE-stroked files (distinct assets, not recoloured).

heading.note: may contain a literal <span>, painted by the component via [&_span]:text-dust/50

provenance.note: Provenance of this asset in the page being specified. `generated` is FORBIDDEN for any assetRole whose generationPolicy is must-not-fabricate-real-brand or must-not-fabricate-compliance-claim, and for must-reuse-exact roles. Enforced by compatibility/graph.json#ASSET_PROVENANCE_POLICY and schema/semantic_validate.py.

aspectRatio.note: CSS aspect-ratio for the wrapper box (e.g. "799/617"). Used by Rive assets, which have no intrinsic pixel size, INSTEAD of intrinsicWidth/Height.

constraints._variantRouteAllowlistNote: Each variant is pinned to the exact routes that really use it, read off the real content data. Enforced by compatibility/graph.json#VARIANT_ROUTE_ALLOWLIST at severity "error", keyed on (section, variant) — not on the bare section id.

variants.theme-dark: /about — heading present, white-stroked icons, assetRole illustration.feature-icon

notes: This is the ONLY section id that legitimately appears on more than one template. Structural rules that touch it MUST key on (section, variant), not on the bare id.
`heading` is genuinely absent on /security (the CMS value is null) and present on /about. It is therefore OPTIONAL, not required — verified by reading the real SECURITY_ICON_GRID object.
copyBudgetDerivation: Each maxWords budget is max(measured+2, ceil(measured*1.25)). The measured maxima were computed by importing the real src/data/*.js modules and word-counting every string for that field across every route. See extraction/measured-values.json#copyBudgets.
